enriched_activities.desc: Lie in bed. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn to left side. Move right arm. Adjust pillow. Turn to right side. Pull blanket up. Bend knees. Stretch legs. Turn to back. Move head. Lie still. Breathe deeply. Continue sleeping.

Sit up on bed. Swing legs over edge. Stand up. Walk to bathroom. Turn on bathroom light. Turn on shower. Adjust water temperature. Step into shower. Wet body. Pick up soap. Rub soap on body. Rinse body. Pick up shampoo. Pour shampoo into hand. Rub shampoo into hair. Rinse hair. Turn off shower. Step out of shower. Pick up towel. Dry body and hair.

Walk to kitchen. Turn on kitchen light. Open refrigerator. Take out milk. Take out cereal. Close refrigerator. Open cabinet. Take out bowl. Take out spoon. Close cabinet. Pour cereal into bowl. Pour milk into bowl. Sit at table. Eat cereal. Drink milk. Finish eating. Stand up. Pick up bowl and spoon. Walk to sink. Rinse bowl and spoon.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed and preparing for work
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Open wardrobe. Take out shirt. Take out pants. Take out socks. Take out underwear. Close wardrobe. Remove towel. Put on underwear. Put on socks. Put on pants. Put on shirt. Button shirt. Tuck shirt. Put on belt. Walk to mirror. Comb hair. Put on deodorant. Put on watch. Pick up phone.

Walk out of house. Lock door. Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Tap transit card. Find seat. Sit down. Put bag on lap. Look out window. Check phone. Listen to music. Bus arrives at stop. Stand up. Walk to exit. Get off bus. Walk to workplace. Enter building. Greet colleague. Walk to locker room.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a health care professional
enriched_activities.desc: Enter hospital. Walk to locker room. Change into scrubs. Put on ID badge. Walk to nurse station. Check patient list. Pick up clipboard. Walk to patient room. Knock on door. Enter. Greet patient. Check vitals. Measure blood pressure. Record data. Administer medication. Update chart. Walk to next patient. Repeat tasks. Take lunch break. Eat lunch.

Walk out of workplace. Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Tap transit card. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Check phone. Bus arrives at stop. Stand up. Walk to exit. Get off bus. Walk home. Unlock door. Enter house. Remove shoes. Put down bag. Walk to bedroom. Change into casual clothes.

Walk to kitchen. Turn on kitchen light. Open refrigerator. Take out ingredients. Close refrigerator. Place on counter. Open drawer. Take out knife and cutting board. Wash vegetables. Chop vegetables. Turn on stove. Place pan on stove. Add oil. Add ingredients. Stir. Turn off stove. Take out plate. Serve food. Sit at table. Eat dinner.

enriched_activities.activity: Relaxing and avoiding high electricity use during peak hours
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Sit on sofa. Pick up book. Open book. Read pages. Turn page. Close book. Put down book. Pick up phone. Unlock phone. Scroll. Put down phone. Stand up. Walk to window. Look outside. Walk back. Sit down. Pick up magazine. Flip pages. Put down magazine.

enriched_activities.activity: Doing laundry using washing machine after peak hours
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Turn on bathroom light. Open washing machine door. Pick up laundry basket. Sort clothes. Load clothes into washing machine. Close door. Open detergent drawer. Pour detergent. Close drawer. Set cycle. Press start. Wait for wash cycle. Walk to living room. Sit. Wait. Return to bathroom. Open washing machine door. Take out clothes. Hang clothes on rack.

enriched_activities.activity: Leisure activities such as watching TV or using computer
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Sit on sofa. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Change channel. Watch TV. Stand up. Walk to computer. Sit at desk. Turn on computer. Open browser. Browse internet. Type. Click. Stand up. Walk to sofa. Sit down. Pick up phone. Check messages. Put down phone.

Walk to bedroom. Turn on bedroom light. Take off clothes. Put on pajamas. Walk to bathroom. Brush teeth. Wash face. Walk back to bedroom. Turn off bedroom light. Lie on bed. Pull blanket. Close eyes. Turn to side. Adjust pillow. Breathe deeply. Sleep.
